question: Which goddess in the syllable la grants the fruit of gifting land?
premises: The syllable la is the locus of identification.
The goddess Pṛthivī is present in that syllable.
She grants the fruit of giving land.
inference: The syllable la embodies the goddess Pṛthivī as giver of the fruit of land-gifts.
plain_english: In the syllable la is the goddess Pṛthivī, who grants the fruit of giving land.
